issues.finding: The disjunctive abbreviation for A→B has a closing parenthesis after B but no matching opening parenthesis: $\lnot !A \lor !B)$. The expression is intended to be ¬A∨B.
issues.proposed_resolution: Remove only the unmatched closing parenthesis in the target, giving $\lnot !A \lor !B$; keep the frozen source unchanged and preserve the alternative abbreviation.

translation_treatment: Translated definitions and abbreviation prose while preserving term-token and TeX-command order; corrected one unmatched parenthesis in the target conditional abbreviation.
